NARRATOR.style: Warm, calm storyteller for children; unhurried fairy-tale pace, gentle smile in the voice, clear Russian.

MERCHANT.style: Kind, caring father; warm and friendly, a little worried and tender when speaking to his daughters.

ELDEST.style: Proud, confident elder sister; bright, slightly spoiled and demanding tone.

MIDDLE.style: Smooth, vain middle sister; light and sweet, a little capricious.

YOUNGEST.style: Gentle, sincere youngest daughter; soft, youthful and kind, brave and affectionate.

BEAST.style: Deep, slow, rumbling but gentle voice; sad and tender, never frightening for children; at first sternly, then warmly.

VOICES.style: Eerie chorus of wild forest voices, loud and menacing but fairy-tale playful, not scary for children.

PRINCE.style: Young, bright and joyful prince; warm, noble, grateful, with relief and happiness.
